'''Vissfil's brother''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Brolf]] who worked for the resistance leader codenamed [[Filvian (Brolf)|Patriot]]<ref name="Outbound Flight" /> in [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]].<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of [[Outbound Flight (novel)|''Outbound Flight'']] to [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]].</ref> Patriot was in turn working for [[Kinman Doriana/Legends|Kinman Doriana]] codenamed 'Defender' who was building a [[Missile/Legends|missile]] that he said was to assassinate [[Passel Argente/Legends|Passel Argente]]. While [[Lorana Jinzler]] followed [[Jhompfi]], whom she had seen accepting two stolen [[burst thrusters]] from [[Duefgrin]], she was cornered by [[Vissfil]] and his [[Gender/Legends|brother]]. While Vissfil was armed with an [[Axe/Legends|ax]], his shorter brother was armed with a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]]. On their way to deliver Jinzler to Patriot and Defender, the brothers knocked Jinzler out with a strong sedative. Later [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin]] showed up to rescue her. Vissfil and his brother were turned over to the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Police officer/Legends|police]] when they were found guarding Lorana and nothing more is known about them.<ref name="Outbound Flight" />
